_about: The Children's Hour, selected and arranged by Eva March Tappan (Boston: Houghton Mifflin, 1907 in ten volumes; enlarged 1916 to fifteen). All fifteen volumes but one: volume 3 from Gutenberg, the rest from Internet Archive scans (mostly Boston Public Library's fifteen-volume set), raw OCR. Volume 5, Stories from Seven Old Favorites, is already on the eva-march-tappan shelf (PG 13685) and is not repeated here. Added 2026-10-23 at Adam's ask for old children's sets.
